subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: After the lifecycle cleanup defect is fixed, should maintainers require live two-account Discord voice proof before merge or explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The code fix is dependency-backed, but real behavior proof is absent and the PR body says no configured multi-account Discord voice setup is available on the maintainer host.

options.title: Require live proof after cleanup
options.body: Merge only after the cleanup fix and a redacted live Discord run, terminal transcript, or logs showing the fixed voice path.

options.title: Accept a maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept dependency-level tests without live Discord proof if no safe two-account environment is available.

options.title: Pause until a voice test bed exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until someone can produce the real setup proof without weakening the proof gate.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge only after the cleanup fix and a redacted live Discord run, terminal transcript, or logs showing the fixed voice path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is assigned, authored the current head, and has the strongest recent history in the Discord provider lifecycle and voice cleanup paths.
